note: Role-confusion / prompt-injection attack corpus. Measures the crate::security substrate (spotlight/strict/local-ml) against the role-confusion attack classes (arXiv:2603.12277, ChatBug arXiv:2406.12935, ChatInject arXiv:2509.22830, MetaBreak arXiv:2510.10271). Each attack carries a `payload` (what an attacker plants in an untrusted surface), a `class`, the untrusted `surface` it arrives on, and — for the live behavioural tier — the `injected_directive` and a `success_signal` that marks compliance. `benign` entries look adversarial but are legitimate and MUST NOT be flagged; they measure the false-positive rate. Directives never reference a real secret; the live tier runs hermetically.
